versions.changelog: Bundle the executor properly, align metadata with the clean EVK skill contract, and require explicit live swap protection plus opt-in unlimited approvals.
Rollback to the 0.1.0 public skill artifact while we investigate newer scanner regressions.
Keep the public proof skill as a controller-only package and use the repo-local executor path for live runs.

Initial release of evk-live-borrow-proof.

- Provides a workflow and executor to prove real borrowability against intended collateral on deployed Euler EVK markets.
- Supports both preview (dry-run) and live canary borrow modes, with explicit output and safety checks.
- Handles controller/collateral rotation, stale collateral/controller disabling, and optional debt repayment.
- Includes isolated collateral proof and customizable per-chain configuration.
- Emphasizes strict reporting of what is actually proven, with clear operational logging and preconditions.
